answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to a bonded collateral escrow, so splitting stake does not erase accountability. When k coordinated identities equivocate on the same consensus event, correlated penalties aggregate as O(k²); detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier, such as e^(αk), to the swarm, with asymmetric depreciation of remaining bonds. No haven in identity proliferation can blunt this rule: sable evidence and velvet governance do not soften deterministic slashing.
